summary: Completed comprehensive testing of the data backup/export feature. All backend API tests passed (9/9) and frontend UI tests verified all features working correctly. Export APIs return proper paginated responses, Dashboard shows Backup Now button, toast reminders appear on login, and downloads trigger successfully with proper filename format.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/export/patients returns paginated response {data, count, total, skip, limit}
Backend: GET /api/export/visits returns paginated response {data, count, total}
Backend: Export endpoints require authentication (401 without token)
Backend: Export returns actual patient data when user has patients
Backend: Export visits supports date_from/date_to filtering
Backend: backup_test@test.com user can login and access export APIs
Frontend: Dashboard page loads with 'Backup Now' button visible (data-testid='backup-now-btn')
Frontend: 'Quick Add' button is visible and functional (data-testid='quick-add-patient-btn')
Frontend: Toast reminder appears on login - 'You haven't backed up your data yet'
Frontend: Clicking 'Backup Now' shows 'Starting backup...' toast
Frontend: Backup shows 'No data to backup' for empty accounts
Frontend: Backup triggers file download for accounts with data
Frontend: Backup success shows 'Backup complete: X patients, Y visits'
Frontend: Downloaded file has correct naming format 'EMR_Backup_YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.json'
critical_code_review_comments: Export API response format correctly uses paginated structure: {data: [], count, total, skip, limit}
Frontend correctly handles paginated response by accessing response.data.data || response.data
AutoExportProvider properly shows reminder toast on login when last backup > 24 hours ago
handleBackupNow function in DashboardPage.js correctly creates Blob and triggers download via anchor element
seed_data_creation: test_export_backup.py creates temporary test patients for testing, then cleans up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data backup/export feature fully tested and working.
